property_summary: For any non-keeper caller and any admissible deposit amount, executeBatchDeposit must not advance the batching round (the onlyKeeper guard reverts), so c.currentRound() always remains 1; the mutant lets any caller execute the batch deposit and increments currentRound to 2.
change_summary: Remove the `if (msg.sender != keeper) revert CallerNotKeeper();` check from the onlyKeeper modifier so any address can call executeBatchDeposit and alter dnGmxJuniorVaultGlpBalance.
